title: Udaasi chhayi rahi
body:
Udaasi chhayi rahi tere janaze pe HASAN
"Paraye des ke manind lag raha tha WATAN
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Hadaf na apne sitam ka ise banao ruko..
Lab-e-HUSSAIN pe jaari raha ye gham ka SUKHAN
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Chalaye teer janaze pe ahle yasrab ne..
Lahu me gharq hai dekho badan bhi aur KAFAN
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Rasool e Paak bhi zer e Lahad tadapte hai'n..
Jo tujhpe teero ki baarish hui hai Haaye HASAN
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Hussain aaj hai tanha sambhal lo ghazi...
Hasan hue hai juda dil me mustakil hai chubha'n
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Kabhi Na Aisa Janaza kisi ne dekha hai.
Ki paash paash kaleja bhi aur Zakhmi BADAN
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Ajeeb haal me wapas janaza aaya hai..
Bhare hai teer janaze me gharq e khoon hai TAN
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Kareeb e binte ali is kadar sitam pahucha
Yaqee'n huwa hai ki Haatho'n me hogi jald RASAN
<<DIVIDER>>
8. "Shabih" aaj hain girya kuna zamee'n o falak
Haram huwe hai'n Azadar mehwe Ranj o mahan
